module: Flowgraph node "Set Drag Vehicles" (category once_instant). Registers the race vehicles in gameplay_drag_dragBridge.setVehicles. The per-lane input pins (vehId_i, isPlayable_i, dial_i, lane_i) are created dynamically according to the number chosen in the editor (count, saved). Output: flow (pulse).
notes: Lanes without a valid vehId (> 0) are ignored; if the list is empty, the node gives no flow.
Default values: isPlayable false, dial -1, lane 1.
When pins are removed, only the links whose sourcePin matches are deleted (the comparison is made on sourcePin although these are input pins).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Editor: count field and choice of the merge function.

updatePins.desc: Adds or removes the per-lane pins to go from old to new.

workOnce.desc: Builds the list {id, isPlayable, dial, lane} and calls dragBridge.setVehicles.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores mode and count and recreates the pins.
